run_map_dataset: run the map_datasets script to convert a dataset to KILT format using dataset_mapper.map_dataset
create_natural_questions_dataset: create a NaturalQuestionsDataset from a config file using NaturalQuestionsDataset.from_config_file with a name and JSON config path
map_natural_questions_dev: map the Natural Questions dev set to KILT format by loading it via from_config_file and passing it to map_dataset
review_dataset_mapper: review the dataset_mapper module which uses ThreadPool to process dataset chunks in parallel and write KILT JSON output
refactor_dataset_mapping: refactor the map_datasets script to add additional datasets like HotpotQA or EntityLinking to the datasets list before mapping
